issues.claim: Most AI answers come from memory
issues.problem: "Most" is an unquantified statistic; the supportable claim is that a plain LLM answers from knowledge stored in its parameters.
issues.fix: A plain AI model answers from memory, but RAG lets it open the book first.

issues.problem: Sources say you update the external knowledge base instead of retraining; the sentence omits that step.
issues.fix: It answers using them, so you update the knowledge base, not retrain the model.

issues.claim: It can even cite sources, which beats guessing from memory.
issues.problem: Citing is supported (AWS, Wikipedia), but 'beats guessing' is rhetoric; Wikipedia notes RAG reduces but does not prevent hallucinations.
issues.fix: It can even cite sources, so you can check its answers.
